summary: Actual v003 images were inspected against the reference: matched three-view comparison, face, uniform clay, hand, ear and foot details. Both downloaded artifact digests, exact Release manifest bytes and model hash match; real Blender 4.0.2 reopen checks pass and CI readback verifies 66 files. C-shaped jaw and continuous digits improve v002, but geometry is not accepted: exposed upper jaw tube ends form cheek fins, the oral floor has a see-through gap, an overlong foot base hides most toe domes, torso/limb curves remain boxy, damage edges are sawtoothed, the thumb has a double bulge and ear/bow surfaces need local smoothing. Create NEW form-v004 from this valid snapshot. No texture work. See form-v003.md.
